requirement.description: StructLayout class is missing the const() method that should be available for creating constant values. Tests expect to call .const() on StructLayout instances but get AttributeError.
requirement.contract: The StructLayout class must implement a const() method that accepts a mapping or sequence of field values and returns a constant value representing the layout. The method should handle field conversion using the layout's _convert_to_int method and return a Const object with the appropriate value.

requirement.description: Signal class is missing the as_value() method that should be available for ValueCastable objects. Tests expect to call .as_value() on Signal instances but get AttributeError.
requirement.contract: The Signal class must implement an as_value() method that returns the underlying Value representation. Since Signal inherits from Value, this should be implemented to return self.

requirement.description: View class __getattr__ method doesn't properly handle error messages for missing attributes. Tests expect specific error messages but get generic AttributeError messages.
requirement.contract: The View.__getattr__ method must provide more informative error messages when accessing non-existent fields. It should suggest similar field names and clearly indicate that the field doesn't exist.

requirement.description: Layout base class is missing the __call__ method that allows creating Views from layouts and signals. Tests expect to be able to call layouts as functions but get TypeError.
requirement.contract: The Layout base class must implement a __call__ method that creates a View from a layout and a target value. This method should accept a target value and return a View instance.
